Original models/materials: HappyToyV2 bespoke Blender/procedural assets.
Candle flame: original AI-generated photographic-style transparent raster; OpenAI built-in image generation.
Source models and attribution records preserved under SourceArt/GraphicsUpgrade.

Korean corridor jangseung, onggi and dokkaebi-inspired roof tile: generated for this project with the designated A100 Studio / TRELLIS.2 webapp, using original built-in ImageGen references; locally finished in Blender 4.0.2.
References, original GLB/PBR, prompts, job provenance, editable Blender and backend license are preserved under SourceArt/KoreanCorridorProps.

School horror surfaces also retain finishing inputs from worn_plaster_wall listed above (CC0 1.0).
Correlated mold, leak, crack and wetness finishing, physical material shader and Korean notice layouts are authored for HappyToyV2.
Original user visual reference, exact map/font inputs, reproducible generators and output hashes: SourceArt/SchoolHorror.

Concrete Debris — Amal Kumar — https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_debris

Both assets: Poly Haven CC0 1.0. Concrete debris is acquired photographed height/PBR data used for relief patches; the small aggregate pieces derive from the actual individual photogrammetry meshes.
Original editable Blender files and referenced maps, source checksums, pinned Blender derivative tools and packed game authoring source: SourceArt/SchoolHorror/StructuralDecay.

학교 시작 자바라: 지정 modeling webapp / TRELLIS.2에서 생성한 접힌 철문과 단일 자물쇠 원본을 Blender4.0.2에서 게임 LOD/PBR로 마감했다. 사용자 참조·ImageGen 입력/프롬프트·실제 완료 작업·원본 GLB/8K·packed Blender·도구 고지와 재현 해시는 SourceArt/SchoolRetractableGate에 보존한다.

학교 진행 디지털 시계: built-in ImageGen 입력을 지정 A100 modeling CLI / TRELLIS.2에서 원본 GLB·8K PBR로 생성하고 Blender 4.0.2에서 두 게임 LOD·1K PBR로 마감했다. 실제 입력/정확한 프롬프트·요청/작업·원본·packed Blender·재현 도구/해시는 SourceArt/SchoolProgressClock에 보존한다. 7세그먼트 LED는 진행 상태에 맞춰 게임에서 표시한다.
